283:t_013:0.en:
$$ミレイナ$$
「Analysis of the enemy Unknowns' erosion attack is complete!」

283:t_013:1.en:
$$フェルト$$
「As suspected, the Unknowns' attacks seem to be aimed at assimilating or fusing with their targets!」

283:t_013:2.en:
$$フェルト$$
「When an attack hits, it seems to shock the pilot's mind and brain, not just damage the unit!」

283:t_013:3.en:
$$フェルト$$
「If a pilot loses consciousness, they can't resist the Unknowns' erosion!」

283:t_013:4.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「If that happens, there's nothing we can do. Once a pilot has taken a certain amount of damage, we have no choice but to pull them back.」

283:t_013:5.en:
$$シン$$
「What the hell are those things!」

283:t_013:6.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「...There's no pilot aboard those...」

283:t_013:13.en:
$$レド$$
「Alien life forms that attack humanity and can't be communicated with...」

283:t_013:15.en:
$$スメラギ$$
(I don't understand... Why would those $$バアル$$ go after $$ソレスタルビーイング$$'s base...?)

283:t_013:16.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「How are we supposed to fight something like this!?」

283:t_013:17.en:
$$赤木$$
「But this is bad! At this rate the base will...!」

283:t_013:18.en:
$$ミレイナ$$
「$$ノリエガ$$! Something's coming out of the base's dock!」

283:t_014:1.en:
$$バナージ$$
「So you finished it, the $$ダブルオークアンタ$$!」

283:t_014:2.en:
$$刹那$$
「Sorry to keep you waiting, $$バナージ$$.」

283:t_014:3.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「It can't be called perfect yet, but at the very least it's in better shape than it was during the $$時獄戦役$$.」

283:t_014:4.en:
$$イアン$$
「I'm counting on you, $$刹那$$! A good number of $$イノベイド$$ pitched in to tune that thing!」

283:t_014:5.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「Let's do this for them too, the ones in the base, $$刹那$$.」

283:t_014:8.en:
$$刹那$$
「I can't... put it into words well...」

283:t_014:9.en:
$$カミーユ$$
(So $$刹那$$ feels it too...)

283:t_014:10.en:
$$アムロ$$
(That strange unease about the Unknowns...)

283:t_014:11.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「All units, re-form up around the $$ダブルオークアンタ$$!」

283:t_014:12.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「To avoid the Unknowns' erosion, if a pilot's mental state becomes dangerous, I'll give the order to withdraw!」

283:t_014:15.en:
$$刹那$$
($$ダブルオークアンタ$$... The fight between you and me starts now...)

283:t_015:0.en:
$$フェルト$$
「Annihilation of the Unknowns confirmed.」

283:t_015:1.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「A new enemy... Are those $$バアル$$ too...」

283:t_015:3.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Amazing, the $$ダブルオークアンタ$$.」

283:t_015:4.en:
$$シン$$
「And it's still not finished... How strong is it going to get?」

283:t_015:5.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「True, as it stands the $$ダブルオークアンタ$$ has not succeeded in fully converting the $$ツインドライヴ$$'s GN particles into weaponry.」

283:t_015:6.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「But the completion of the $$ダブルオークアンタ$$ lies on a different plane from combat strength.」

283:t_015:8.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「When the time comes, you'll understand. And for that, it will need $$刹那$$'s power as an $$イノベイター$$.」

283:t_015:9.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「A machine built to use 100% of an $$イノベイター$$'s abilities...」

283:t_015:10.en:
$$アムロ$$
(The concept is the same as the $$ユニコーン$$'s full $$サイコ・フレーム$$...)

283:t_015:11.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「First we'll sort out our information on the Unknowns. All units, return.」

283:t_016:0.en:
$$ロックオン$$
「All right! I'm in top form, and so is $$ガンダムサバーニャ$$!」

283:t_016:1.en:
$$ハロ$$
「Nice one, $$ロックオン$$. Nice one, $$ロックオン$$.」

283:t_016:2.en:
$$青ハロ$$
「$$ロックオン$$, ladies' man. $$ロックオン$$, ladies' man.」

283:t_016:3.en:
$$ロックオン$$
「You picked up $$赤木$$'s words, huh...」

283:t_016:4.en:
$$ロックオン$$
「I don't know if I'm a ladies' man or not, but there's someone in that base! I won't let anything lay a single finger on them!」

283:t_017:2.en:
$$ラッセ$$
「Damn! We couldn't protect the base!」

283:t_017:3.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「If it ends like this, even if we defeat the enemy...」

283:t_100:0.en:
$$ノノ$$
(Why is that...? I can tell that these $$宇宙怪獣$$ are different from the ones we fought at the center of the galaxy...)

283:t_100:1.en:
$$ノノ$$
(What is this...? My chest feels all fuzzy...)

283:t_101:0.en:
$$ラルク$$
「Come at me if you're coming, $$バアル$$!」

283:t_101:1.en:
$$ラルク$$
「You and the $$宇宙怪獣$$ from the galactic center, the $$バスターマシン$$s will take you all on at once!」

283:t_102:0.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「So these are the $$宇宙怪獣$$ of a parallel world...」

283:t_102:1.en:
$$ノリコ$$
(What's going on...? This world has the same $$宇宙怪獣$$ as the world I came from, and yet...)

283:t_102:2.en:
$$ノリコ$$
(If $$宇宙怪獣$$ exist across parallel worlds, then what are the things right in front of me...)

283:t_103:0.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「I can feel something from the Unknowns in front of me...」

283:t_103:1.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「I can't tell... Is this hostility... or some other emotion...」

283:t_104:0.en:
$$バナージ$$
(What is this...!? It's like an enormous number of people are screaming at the same time...!)

283:t_104:1.en:
$$バナージ$$
(Is this... the will of these Unknowns...)

283:t_105:0.en:
$$アムロ$$
(The will the Unknowns are emitting... What is this...)

283:t_105:1.en:
$$アムロ$$
(I can't tell... Are they creatures whose way of thinking is nothing like ours...)

283:t_106:0.en:
$$シャア$$
「Tch...! They seem to have some intent, but I can't grasp it...!」

283:t_106:1.en:
$$シャア$$
「Since they're coming at us to do harm, do we have no choice but to fight back...!」

283:t_107:1.en:
$$フォウ$$
「You felt it too, $$クェス$$.」

283:t_107:2.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「Why... Why can we tell that this thing has a will...」

283:t_107:3.en:
$$クェス$$
「I don't know, that kind of thing! These guys are attacking us!」

283:t_107:4.en:
$$フォウ$$
「Rather than prying into what they are, all we can do now is fight...!」

ノリエガ.evidence: Surname form of the glossary's スメラギ・李・ノリエガ (Sumeragi Lee Noriega); Mileina addresses Sumeragi by it at 283:t_013:18. No bare token in the sheet.

uncertain: 283:t_013:18: ノリエガさん taken as Mileina addressing Sumeragi (Sumeragi Lee Noriega); rendered with proposed new token $$ノリエガ$$ ('Noriega'); $$スメラギ$$ would be the fallback
283:t_016:4: あいつ in the base is unidentified; rendered gender-neutral 'someone ... them'

Bare クアンタ rendered with the full $$ダブルオークアンタ$$ token (as dlg_2039_01/282 did); bare サバーニャ with $$ガンダムサバーニャ$$
アンノウン = 'Unknown(s)', matching other slices
